candidate_scope: multinomial intercept-only adjustment fitted on out-of-fold development probabilities
preprocessing: Fit separately inside every training fold; retain fixed original features and C.
selection: Known-outcome original internal-validation multiclass log loss; ties within 1e-6 retain unchanged model. Report selection as exploratory.
calibration_parameterization: q_k = p_k * exp(a_k) / sum_j(p_j * exp(a_j)); event-free reference a=0. Fit two offsets by unweighted multiclass log loss on development OOF predictions only.

fresh_evaluation.overlap: Exclude entire experiment and investigate if identifiers overlap either prior cohort.
fresh_evaluation.selection_note: Chosen now, after the failed 2011Q1 result, before examining this cohort; one later vintage cannot establish cross-cycle robustness.

acceptance.threshold_basis: Project review criteria fixed after internal development but before accessing the reserved cohort; not regulatory standards or power guarantees.
acceptance.promotion: manual review only after data, performance and limitation checks; no automatic production promotion

stop_rule: If internal calibration does not help, retain unchanged candidate and report no remedy demonstrated. Do not expand search or download more data automatically.
